description: Soft PK/FK, virtual entity, and IS-A relationship configuration for CodeGen. Read by CodeGen from the path configured as `additionalSchemaInfo` in mj.config.cjs. See config/database-metadata-config.template.json for the full field reference.

VirtualEntities.Description: Per-store, per-year pivot of StoreAssessment (AV 2021-2026) and StoreTax (Tax 2022-2026) for the Big Box Retail analysis dashboard. Read-only; filtered to primary (de-duplicated) Store rows.

One row per store per assessment year — the long counterpart to Store Analysis, which spells the same measures into 44 year-suffixed columns. Year is an ordinary filterable column here, a new assessment year needs no schema change, and event-shaped evidence (sales, burden shifts) fits naturally where a wide layout would leave it ~95% NULL. Read-only; primary Store rows only.
